definitions.explanation: The state of being alone; can be negative (lonely) or neutral (solitary).

examples.japanese: {孤独|こどく}な{人生|じんせい}を{送|おく}っている。
{孤独|こどく}{死|し}を{防|ふせ}ぐ{取|と}り{組|く}み。

notes:
{孤独|こどく} means loneliness or solitude, functioning as both a noun and na-adjective.

FORMS:
- Na-adjective: {孤独|こどく}な{生活|せいかつ} (lonely life)
- Noun: {孤独|こどく}を{感|かん}じる (to feel lonely)
- Adverb: {孤独|こどく}に{生|い}きる (to live in solitude)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {孤独|こどく}を{味|あじ}わう: to experience loneliness
- {孤独|こどく}に{耐|た}える: to endure solitude
- {孤独|こどく}{死|し}: dying alone (social issue in Japan)
- {孤独|こどく}{感|かん}: feeling of loneliness

NUANCE:
Can describe either unwanted loneliness or chosen solitude. Context determines whether negative (lonely) or neutral/positive (solitary).

RELATED:
- {孤立|こりつ}: isolation (often forced or circumstantial)
- {寂|さび}しい: lonely (emotional feeling)
